dct_title_s: Municipal Advisory Council Boundaries, Placer County, California, 2020
dct_description_sm: Municipal Advisory Councils (MACs) were established by the Board of Supervisors to advise them on matters of concern which relate to the area served. It is a forum where information about land use, transportation and general county information is shared, discussed and where the MAC members may make recommendations on those topics and more. It is a great venue where residents can attend these meetings in their own community and talk about issues that are important to them.This layer is part of a collection of public geospatial datasets produced by the Placer County GIS Division.
